# CLI

Every command is run as `uv run cowbird <command>` from the repo root.

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` a cowbird error (printed to standard error as
`error: ...`), `2` a timeout (`timeout: ...`). argparse also exits `2` on a
usage error such as an unknown flag. `cowbird canary` exits `1` when any
provider is quarantined, and `0` when providers are only down.

## `cowbird new`

acquire an address

```
usage: cowbird new [-h] [--provider PROVIDER] [--gmail] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--provider` | unset | use this provider instead of the best healthy one |
| `--gmail` | off | require a Gmail alias |
| `--json` | off | print address, provider, TTL and state as JSON |

## `cowbird wait`

wait for mail at an address

```
usage: cowbird wait [-h] --provider PROVIDER [--state STATE] [--otp]
                    [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                    address
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `address` | required | the address `new` printed |
| `--provider` | required | the provider `new` printed |
| `--state` | unset | opaque provider state from `new` |
| `--otp` | off | print only the one-time code |
| `--timeout` | `120` | seconds to wait |

## `cowbird providers`

show the provider health matrix

```
usage: cowbird providers [-h]
```

## `cowbird canary`

probe every provider live and show health

```
usage: cowbird canary [-h] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | off | print status and last failure per provider as JSON |
